title: Fix multiline SSE parsing in streaming chat
author: Dylan Brooks
description:
Fixes a bug where our SSE parser only consumed the first `data:` line per event. When proxies coalesce frames, Redwood may emit multiline `data:` segments that must be concatenated with `
` before JSON.parse. This manifested as missing deltas in streaming chat output (SUP-4835). Adds a dedicated SSE parse helper with unit tests for multiline data and mixed `event:` fields.
review_conversation: Reviewer (Dev): Please ensure we preserve blank lines inside JSON strings.

Author (Dylan): We only join `data:` lines with `
` per spec; JSON strings remain escaped; added a test.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash; released in redwood-sdk-typescript 2.4.1
